体感动作使用去除重力后的加速度、倾斜角或角速度。动作在体感开启后生效；「按住暂停: Motion actions use gravity-compensated acceleration, tilt or angular velocity. They run while gyro is enabled; Hold to pause releases them.
开始观察输入后显示数据: Start monitoring input to see live data
保存并应用基础层配置，启用映射后打开悬浮窗。开始、结束和保存测量都可以在游戏内完: Save and apply the base-layer profile, enable mapping, then open the overlay. You can start, finish, and save the measurement in-game.
测得的手柄转角不足，请重新测量。: The measured controller angle is too small. Measure again.
让游戏镜头转一整圈并回到参照点。松开摇杆，等镜头停稳后结束测量。: Turn the camera one full circle back to the reference point. Release the stick and let the camera settle before finishing.
让游戏镜头从最低转到最高，停稳后结束测量。: Move the camera from its lowest to highest pitch. Let it settle before finishing.
先在游戏内选一个清楚的参照点，再开始测量。: Pick a clear reference point in the game before starting.
水平测量可沿左摇杆外圈转动，再用体感微调。: For horizontal calibration, sweep around the rim of the left stick and fine-tune with gyro.
水平测量可沿右摇杆外圈转动，再用体感微调。: For horizontal calibration, sweep around the rim of the right stick and fine-tune with gyro.
请使用窗口或无边框全屏。游戏锁定光标时，可通过游戏菜单调出光标。: Use windowed or borderless fullscreen mode. If the game locks the cursor, open its menu to bring the cursor back.
请使用窗口或无边框全屏。游戏锁定光标时，可以用上方的校准按键。: Use windowed or borderless fullscreen mode. If the game locks the cursor, use the calibration shortcuts above.

请松开配置层按键，切回基础层后再校准。: Release the layer controls to return to the base layer before calibrating.
请在 Studio 打开校准悬浮窗。: Open the calibration overlay from Studio.

校准悬浮窗正在打开或关闭，请稍后再试。: The calibration overlay is opening or closing. Try again shortly.

请在校准悬浮窗中操作。: Use the calibration overlay for this action.

依次将指定方向朝上并放稳，采集每个轴的正反两面。每个轴两面都记录后，会计算该轴的: Place each indicated face upward and hold still to sample both ends of each axis. The offset and scale are calculated once both faces are recorded. X points toward the right grip, Y toward the controller face, and Z toward your body.
设备噪声与六面校准结果按设备保存在本机。: Noise and six-face calibration results are stored locally for each device.
长按触发后保持，直到松开: Hold after long press activates, until released
普通按住立即生效。短按在松开后确认；双击在第二次按下时生效，保持到松开。同一输入: Regular hold activates immediately. Short press is confirmed on release; double press starts on the second press and lasts until release. An input can have multiple activators. Use short and long press together to avoid also firing a regular hold binding.
最多 4 个输入。组合动作生效时，优先于其中的单键动作。: Up to 4 inputs. An active chord takes priority over its individual inputs.
